If this maximum force magnitude is below the threshold, it logically follows that every individual atomic force (magnitude) must also be below that value.

Both claude-sonnet and gemini-flash concur with this assessment. The technical clarification by claude-sonnet regarding force components versus magnitudes strengthens the conclusion, as VASP's behavior aligns with the interpretation that the reported 'max_force' ensures all atomic force magnitudes are below the threshold.
